intro: A quiet weekend window. Reddit feeds were rate-limited this morning, so there's no Reddit section today.

must_reads.title: Bluesky puts Patreon and Ko-fi pay buttons at the top of creator profiles
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Bluesky now shows several links right under a profile bio, with tip and membership links as big green buttons. Platforms keep changing how links appear, and Bluesky adds no click tracking, so creators still need their own way to measure and route clicks.

must_reads.title: Google’s AI search changes upended online publishing
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Google's AI answers are sending fewer clicks to publishers. Many affiliate sites live on search traffic, so they will look harder at getting more value from every click they still get.

must_reads.title: Meta’s new scraping terms galvanize publishers into collective action
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Publishers are teaming up against Meta's new rules on scraping their content. It's another sign of tension between big platforms and the people who create content for them.

must_reads.title: The Daily Mail tests GEO with brands ahead of AI visibility product
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: A big publisher is selling brands help showing up in AI answers. Being seen by AI assistants is becoming its own marketing channel, next to search and social.

must_reads.title: Why WebKit Did It; Apple’s Car In The Ads Race
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Apple's browser engine is now blocking ad-tech ID vendors after iOS 27. Tracking people across sites keeps getting harder, which puts more weight on first-party link click data.

items.title: Best 11 early Black Friday headphones deals available now
items.summary: Big affiliate publishers are already running early Black Friday roundups, a sign holiday link traffic is ramping up.

items.title: Salesforce’s $5.7 billion Braze deal puts marketers at an ecosystem crossroads
items.summary: Salesforce is buying the customer messaging platform Braze for $5.7 billion, pushing marketers to pick one big ecosystem.

items.title: Media Buying Briefing: Brands push toward retail and social while buyers ponder storm clouds
items.summary: Brands are moving budget toward retail media and social as buyers worry about the months ahead.

items.title: Google Says Some AI Overviews May Expand Automatically for Some Queries
items.summary: Google says some AI Overviews may now open up automatically, taking even more space above the normal results.

items.title: YouTube gains record 15.8% of US TV time in Nielsen's August Gauge
items.summary: YouTube hit a record 15.8% of US TV viewing time in Nielsen's August figures, so more creator videos and their links are watched on TVs.

items.title: What is LitRPG? Inside the rise of the gaming-inspired fantasy genre
items.summary: A look at the rise of LitRPG, the gaming-inspired fantasy genre, much of it driven by self-published authors.
